solution:
The logic followed here is:

@ shifts its position in anticlockwise direction by + 1, +2, +3,.... in each next figure.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5bdf5d7d9a5e4f12eda3060b1201867cd64ce3049778d57406691bbd2501d88b.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1".**
